hooks.name: aidlc-verb-intercept
hooks.description: Runs a read-only or navigation `/aidlc` command itself and hands the assistant the verbatim output, so asking for status or switching intents cannot advance the workflow by accident. Registered with no matcher: the seam also keeps the per-turn clock the engine's roll-forward guard compares against, so it must fire on every prompt, not only on the terminal ones.
